about.title: About Weight Converter
about.description: The Weight Converter is an essential tool for converting between different units of weight and mass. From grams to pounds, kilograms to ounces, this converter handles all common weight measurements used in cooking, shipping, science, and commerce. Weight conversion is crucial in international trade, cooking, fitness tracking, and scientific research. Whether you're following a recipe, calculating shipping costs, or conducting scientific experiments, this tool ensures precise weight conversions with support for both metric and imperial weight systems.

faq.q: What weight units does the converter support?
faq.a: Our weight converter supports metric units (milligrams, grams, kilograms, tonnes), imperial units (ounces, pounds, stones, tons), and specialized units like carats, grains, and troy ounces for comprehensive weight conversion.

faq.q: What's the difference between mass and weight?
faq.a: Mass is the amount of matter in an object (measured in kg), while weight is the gravitational force on that mass (measured in Newtons). For practical weight conversions, these terms are used interchangeably.

faq.q: How accurate are the weight conversions?
faq.a: All weight conversions use precise mathematical formulas with high decimal accuracy. Our converter is suitable for commercial shipping, cooking recipes, scientific research, and professional applications.

faq.q: What is a troy ounce and how is it different?
faq.a: A troy ounce equals 31.1035 grams and is used for precious metals like gold and silver. A regular (avoirdupois) ounce equals 28.3495 grams and is used for general weight measurements.

faq.q: Can I convert very small or very large weights?
faq.a: Yes, our weight converter handles everything from milligrams (for precise measurements) to metric tons (for industrial applications) with appropriate precision and scientific notation support.

faq.q: How do I convert pounds to kilograms quickly?
faq.a: To convert pounds to kilograms, divide by 2.20462. For example, 150 pounds ÷ 2.20462 = 68.04 kg. Our converter automates this calculation instantly with precise results.
